criteria.name: relation_rate_gain
criteria.target: >= 1.5x advantage over baseline across >= 3 adjacent sizes
criteria.justification: Max adjacent sizes with >= 1.5x gain was 0 (required: 3).

criteria.name: scaling_persistence
criteria.target: Advantage persists with increasing bit length
criteria.justification: Advantage did not persist with increasing bit length.

findings: Track A evaluated across 4 bit lengths (16-32 bits).
Observed scaling ratios: 0.00x at 16b (69.3 vs 84010.1 rel/s), 0.00x at 20b (15.9 vs 35578.5 rel/s), 0.00x at 24b (23.9 vs 65090.0 rel/s), 0.00x at 32b (7.7 vs 3471.0 rel/s).
tracks.recommendation: Parametric grid completed: residual cofactor bits scale linearly (~0.90 bits per modulus bit), causing severe yield collapse and 350x–2800x lower throughput than baseline. Conduct at most one bounded multi-vector / BKZ rescue experiment across multiple independent moduli; if residual growth remains catastrophic, park Track A.

tracks.delta: Strong positive signal (gain=18.00x, McNemar p=4.29e-13); confirmatory replication on 20-50 instances warranted before R2 promotion

criteria.name: b1_log_norm_advantage
criteria.justification: Degree-3 base-m representation consistently achieved <= 0.85 coefficient log-norm across all tested moduli.

criteria.name: b3_downstream_yield_promotion
criteria.target: >= 25% smooth relation yield improvement in B3 homogeneous sieve (rule: never promote on B1 alone)
criteria.justification: B3 homogeneous sieve achieved statistically significant paired yield gain (18.00x, p=4.29e-13 <= 0.05) with discordant counts n10=54 vs n01=3.

criteria.name: confirmatory_sample_replication
criteria.target: >= 5 replicated instances per bit length (minimum across all evaluated sizes)
criteria.observed: min 1 instance(s) per size tested (32b: 1, 48b: 1, 64b: 1, threshold: 5)
criteria.justification: Evaluation sample size (minimum 1 per size) is insufficient for R2 promotion; confirmatory replication on 20-50 instances is required.

findings: Multi-fidelity cascade B0-B3 verified algebraic representations across 32-64 bit moduli.
Degree-3 base-m representation measured log-norms: 23.80 (32b), 34.99 (48b), 46.06 (64b) vs deg-2 baseline: 30.68 (32b), 46.79 (48b), 61.97 (64b).
Paired B3 homogeneous sieve measured cubic yield=5.79% vs quadratic=0.32% (gain=18.00x, McNemar exact p=4.29e-13, discordant pairs n10=54 vs n01=3).

Historical NFS degree selection context: For small moduli (32b-64b), degree 2 vs degree 3 yields depend heavily on polynomial coefficient bounds vs algebraic norm growth; higher degree typically shows its decisive asymptotic advantage as modulus size grows.
Pilot evaluated minimum 1 instance per bit size (32b: 1, 48b: 1, 64b: 1). Confirmatory multi-instance replication on 20-50 independent semiprimes is warranted before R2 promotion.
tracks.recommendation: Wave 2 Primary Focus: Replicate paired degree-3 vs degree-2 sieve on 30 independent balanced semiprimes per size across 32b, 48b, 64b, 80b, and 96b using the modulus as the independent experimental unit, and expand beyond canonical base-m to benchmark against Kleinjung/Murphy/CADO-NFS-style polynomial selection.

tracks.delta: Exact rational Sturm/LLL verified at 32b; 40b/48b bound transition incomplete (1/3 recovered)

criteria.name: 50pct_msb_recovery_rate
criteria.target: >=100% exact recovery at 50% known MSB across pilot ladder
criteria.justification: Exact Sturm/LLL small-root solver succeeded on 1/3 instances at 50% MSB (threshold: 100.0%).

criteria.name: calibration_ladder_completeness
criteria.justification: Multi-fraction empirical recovery curve established without synthetic placeholders.

findings: Exact rational Sturm chain root isolation operates with zero IEEE-754 precision loss and recovers exact factors with no fallback.
Observed 50% MSB success rate was 1/3 (32b: SUCCESS (0.12s), 40b: FAIL, 48b: FAIL).
tracks.recommendation: Multi-fraction calibration complete: exact Sturm/LLL root isolation succeeds at >=55% MSB across 32b–48b, confirming the finite-size Coppersmith boundary with zero synthetic placeholders. Maintain Track C as shared infrastructure bridge for any track discovering partial factor bits.

criteria.name: baseline_characterization
criteria.target: Establish clean empirical solve-time scaling curve for Schoolbook SAT
criteria.justification: Clean, reproducible CDCL SAT scaling curve established across 5 consecutive bit lengths with zero semantic errors.

criteria.name: comparative_encoding_advantage
criteria.target: >= 2.0x solve time improvement over schoolbook across >= 3 adjacent sizes
criteria.justification: Alternative encoding failed to achieve consistent 2.0x advantage.

findings: Schoolbook SAT encoding successfully inverted across 16-32 bits with 100% factor recovery.
Empirical CDCL solve time exhibits clean scaling (0.0011s (16b) to 0.2223s (32b)).
tracks.recommendation: CSA-v1 evaluated: sub-2.0x speedups at 16–28 bits with noisy millisecond timings; single 2.30x speedup at 32b is insufficient evidence of algorithmic scaling. Park Track D until a fundamentally new constraint representation (beyond adder-tree rewrites) appears.

proposals.hypothesis: Systematic grid over (factor_base_size x scale_c x candidate_budget) maps the relation collapse boundary on 20-32 bit moduli.
proposals.mechanism: Babai nearest plane relation yield collapsed at 32b; expanding factor base (25-40) and candidate budget (2000) tests whether relation yield recovers.
proposals.expected_effect: relation_discovery_rate > 0 at 32-bit and >= 1.5x gain over baseline
proposals.stopping_rule: stop if 2000 candidates yield 0 relations across all grid points
proposals.novelty_reason: Targeted calibration of relation collapse boundary revealed by PromotionJudge.

proposals.hypothesis: B3 homogeneous sieving on cubic candidates yields >= 25% smooth relations over quadratic base-m on 32-64 bits.
proposals.mechanism: Cubic representation verified in B1 log-norm; Level B3 evaluates true downstream algebraic-sieve relation rate.
proposals.stopping_rule: stop if B3 smooth relation yield is zero after 1000 pairs
proposals.novelty_reason: Evaluating downstream B3 smooth yield per frozen protocol requirement.

proposals.hypothesis: Fine-grained MSB calibration ladder (25%, 35%, 40%, 45%, 50%, 55%, 60%) establishes exact empirical recovery boundary.
proposals.mechanism: Testing genuine partial bit slices across 7 steps determines exact recovery cutoff and lattice dimension scaling limits.
proposals.expected_effect: empirical_recovery_curve mapped across all 7 fractions without synthetic placeholders
proposals.stopping_rule: stop if LLL basis reduction exceeds 60 seconds
proposals.novelty_reason: Full-ladder calibration replacing synthetic negative control.

proposals.hypothesis: Carry-save adder tree encoding reduces SAT conflict count by >= 25% on 32-bit balanced semiprimes.
proposals.mechanism: Reduces clause dependency chain depth compared to ripple-carry adders.
proposals.stopping_rule: stop if D-CANARY-1 semantic equivalence test fails
